title: Managed Database: returned remittances
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database returned remittances applies to database payment return. The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The bank return must identify the exact posted payment. Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned. Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency. A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external reference. A duplicate bank notice produces no new write. Any failed payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under lifecycle and bank fees, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

## Evidence: bank return
The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The evidence is authoritative system evidence assessed before the action, identified by database occurrence reference, original source reference, status, external reference. The correlated evidence must refer together to database occurrence reference, original source reference.
